name: Sanctus

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Cloaked by Shadows
bonuses.text: If this Threat is in cover or hidden by shadows it gains +2 Defence. Additionally, attacks that target this Threat from 12m or more away suffer a +2 DN penalty.

bonuses.name: Passes For Human
bonuses.text: A DN 3 Awareness (Int) Test is required to notice a Sanctusis not Human.

bonuses.name: Soulsight
bonuses.text: This Threat ignores all vision penalties when making attack Tests.

abilities.name: Unquestioning Loyalty
abilities.text: When a Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT and PSYKER Keywords within 6m of this Threat is targeted by a ranged attack, this Threat may interpose themself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack.

abilities.name: Dead-Eye Sniper
abilities.text: After this Threat makes a successful ranged attack, you can spend 1 Ruin to inflict the Vulnerable Condition and a Mortal Wound to the target.

note: No DETERMINATION line printed. Cult Sniper Rifle prints no Salvo; 'Inflict (Poisoned)' has no value; Bio-Dagger 'Inflict (Bleeding, Poisoned)' and 'Rending (10)' kept as printed. 'Sanctusis' in Passes For Human is a print error kept.
